name: Portomarín to Palas de Rei
notes: For Gonzar and Ligonde Photon returned only civil-parish relations (R/12672594 centroid 42.82531,-7.69614 and R/12578544 centroid 42.85740,-7.77876), so they are not used as vias: Castromaior (hamlet node) stands in for Gonzar and A Eirexe de Ligonde (the Eirexe/Airexe of the guides) for Ligonde. Vendas de Narón is OSM's Galician spelling of Ventas de Narón. Hospital da Cruz was not looked up. Order checked by longitude. No variant is known to the author for this stage; Portos and Lestedo are only 0.6 km apart.
